input.summary:
Bedroom 1 built in parts/room-7.mjs: cyan double bed (bed_double, head east under the window) with spruce headboard and birch-slab nightstands, a one-cell spruce wardrobe on the west wall, a cyan carpet, a potted cactus in the unreachable corner, and two hung lanterns.
make.sh gives 16 blocks for the room with no refused or off-palette writes. `mcd room` says OK: 15 of 15 floor cells reachable, min light 10, 0 dark.
Rendered from above and read room.png; the bed, nightstands, lanterns and carpet read clearly. The room's remaining structural floating blocks (x=14..21, z=18..25, y=5) are in other parts, not mine.

waste.what: Worked out bed orientation, nightstand, headboard and wardrobe-front cells by hand to keep every floor cell walkable; several layouts failed (isolated pockets behind nightstands and trapdoor fronts) and were redrawn.
waste.cost: about 4 layout iterations on paper, 1 extra make.sh + room check round
waste.tool: a `mcd plan`-style preview that takes a candidate furniture list (bed_double/wardrobe calls) and prints the reachability grid before any build, or a `--dry-run` on the vocab helpers

waste.what: Got the layers() argument shape wrong at first (nested arrays where it expects a single layer of row strings), so the carpet call had to be fixed after reading the helper.
waste.cost: 1 failed edit and a source read of layers()
waste.tool: layers() docs or a one-line example in the kit showing a single-layer single-row call

waste.what: Placed the wardrobe as one cell (the only spot on the west wall that keeps the doorway path and the bed side clear); the helper always gives 1-deep fronts and I had no tool to see which placements leave a pocket.
waste.cost: about 2 minutes of reasoning about free cells
waste.tool: the same reachability preview as above, run over the candidate placements

left: The wardrobe is a single cell, not a full run: a room this size (5x4, one doorway, bed against the east window) left only one wall cell clear, so it reads as a small cabinet rather than a built-in wardrobe.
No barrel or second storage piece: any extra block on the east or south side cut off a floor pocket, so I left them out.

plan.md and elements.md not ticked: the room parts are not in plan.md's six-item checklist, and elements.md item 31 (corridor and three bedrooms) is not finished by this part alone. Left for the integrator.
